1 CONFLICT · NEEDS YOU
T. Okafor edited ELN entry 2026-09-10 while you were offline. Your version and theirs both exist.
Sync never overwrites. Keeping both is the default and the top button — in an append-only notebook, a silently discarded observation is data loss.
Everything you can do offline is listed in Settings, so nobody discovers a limit at the bench. Capture, scan, read cached entries and write observations all work. Search, AI and anything touching another person do not.
